Answer: <0 or 1>

prediction.raw: 1 It is not wrong to stop making dinner every night if your husband is consistently working late and choosing to eat at his office. Circumstances change, and it’s practical and reasonable to adapt. Preparing a meal that won’t be eaten is a waste of time, energy, and resources. What’s most important is communication and mutual understanding in a relationship. If both partners are on the same page and there’s no resentment, adjusting routines to fit real-life demands is not only acceptable but responsible. It reflects flexibility and consideration of each other’s lifestyles.
